t: A classic open hardware Linux board with two tiny real-time helper cores.
steps: Buy the board from a distributor such as DigiKey or Newark. Prices run about 54 to 63 US dollars.
Get a mini-USB cable or a 5 volt barrel jack power supply.
Get a 3.3 volt USB serial cable for console access or a micro HDMI cable and screen.
Power the board and let the preloaded Debian start from the built-in storage.
Follow the getting started guide on the BeagleBoard docs site.
Blink an onboard LED with a short Python example.
Read the header pin maps and wire your first sensor.
meta: Open Board. From $53.77. A few stores.
